worldcombat.skill.magnetrise.summary: Magnetizes the ground underfoot and lifts the body on magnetism; while afloat, Ground-type moves and ground hazards cannot hurt it, and turning such a hit aside repels a grounded attacker by the same pole. When the magnetism runs out or is cut, the body drops.
worldcombat.skill.magnetrise.use.0: Dodge Earthquake and other Ground moves
worldcombat.skill.magnetrise.use.1: Knock grounded attackers back when a Ground move or hazard is turned aside
worldcombat.skill.magnetrise.description: The field holds the body aloft for %1$s: damage from Ground-type moves and from ground hazards such as falls, cacti, sweet berry bushes and hitting a wall is turned aside. It fades and the body drops when it expires or is dispelled (such as by milk), and recasting only refreshes it. Holding an Iron Ball disables the whole field.
When such a Ground move or hazard is turned aside, a grounded attacker within 3.5 blocks is pushed back about %1$s blocks, at most once per second.
Lifting off takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. The gliding form also grants a burst of movement speed; see the magnetic form note for the trade-off.
worldcombat.skill.magnetrise.field.0: Glide: speed bonus x1.35, -2 ticks wind-up, x0.85 cooldown, at x0.8 duration and x0.7 repulsion — light and quick but short.
worldcombat.skill.magnetrise.field.1: Anchor: duration x1.25, repulsion x1.4, at +2 ticks wind-up, x1.15 cooldown and no speed bonus — holds and repels longer, but slower and costlier.
worldcombat.skill.magnetrise.timing: Cast on yourself: after %1$s of preparation it spends %3$s PP; the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %4$s from commit.
Glide: duration x0.8 and repulsion x0.7, in exchange for a x1.35 speed bonus, -2 ticks wind-up and x0.85 cooldown — good to fight on the move. Anchor: duration x1.25, repulsion x1.4, at +2 ticks wind-up, x1.15 cooldown and no speed bonus — good to hold ground against Ground moves.
The partner only considers lifting off while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger prepares earlier.
Dodge Ground moves: only lift off while a Ground-type threat is near or a foe is hitting the partner with a Ground move. Anytime: lift off on any threat as standing defence.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to lift off.
